name: Oyashio
scope: Selected southwestward Oyashio corridor south of Bussol Strait, followed by the first intrusion along eastern Honshu, to an OSW nominal gate at 40 N. Alternative southern gates use seasonal index limits at 38.5 N in April and 41.5 N in December. Excludes upstream East Kamchatka Current, Sea of Okhotsk circuits, offshore return branch into Subarctic Current, eastward Oyashio Extension/front and detached eddies. This branch convention is not the complete Oyashio system.
layer: Upper-ocean regional corridor with a southern gate informed by the 5 C isotherm at 100 m. A temperature-defined intrusion index is not a velocity axis; no fixed-depth core or isotherm geometry extracted.
time_convention: Regional naming with alternative seasonal intrusion-index gates; 40 N is an OSW intermediate comparison choice, not an annual-mean endpoint. No contemporary dated axis or seasonal length observations.
source_locator: The Oyashio Current, printed pp. 391-392 / PDF indices 7-8: naming south of Bussol Strait, split after Hokkaido, first intrusion and seasonal 100 m temperature-defined limits. Figure 11 caption on p. 393 specifies the JMA index region.
source_citation: Qiu (2019), Kuroshio and Oyashio Currents, Encyclopedia of Ocean Sciences, 3rd edition, 384-394, doi:10.1016/B978-0-12-409548-9.11295-3.
coordinate_selection: OSW chooses the Pacific-side start at 151.8 E / 46.2 N south of Bussol Strait, all longitudes and coarse vertices. The source locates the strait at 151.5 E / 46.5 N; this route does not traverse it. April/December alternatives change only the southern gate. All waypoints remain editorial and no source map or temperature contour is digitized.
scenario_rule: Three southern gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets: 81 editorial scenarios, not statistical uncertainty or an observed seasonal length distribution.

alternative_routes.interpretation: April 38.5 N temperature-index gate, with editorial connecting vertices; not an observed April axis.
December 41.5 N temperature-index gate; no seasonal velocity field reconstructed.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
